purpose: Test a structurally distinct prior-day-liquidity reversal source after plain London/COMEX opening-range families failed strong promotion.
hypothesis: A first sweep of the prior trading-day high/low followed by causal reclaim and optional micro-structure shift may identify short-horizon reversal entries with better frozen 30-second economics.
falsification_condition: No preregistered confirmation lane passes the frozen supply gate and nonnegative strong-pass economic gate.

source_basis.title: Liquidity Sweep Detector - PDH/PDL Levels
source_basis.logic: intraday-accurate previous-day high/low; mark breaches/sweeps of PDH/PDL

source_basis.title: AG Pro Previous Day Sweep & Reclaim
source_basis.logic: specific sequence sweep prior-day extreme then reclaim back inside

source_basis.title: Daily Sweep Strategy
source_basis.logic: PDH/PDL sweep that fails to sustain, closes back inside, then requires local market-structure shift

source_basis.title: Gold - A Simple Liquidity Sweep Play
source_basis.logic: gold previous-high sweep followed by reversal/retest; used only as community corroboration

causal_contract.prior_day_definition: most recent prior UTC trading day containing canonical ticks
causal_contract.sweep: first strict tick breach of either prior-day level
causal_contract.c03_mss: after S5 reclaim, require completed S5 close through the reversal-side extreme of the five completed S5 bars immediately preceding the sweep

decision_rule: Advance only a preregistered strong-pass lane. Otherwise retire without post-result confirmation-window, level, side, session, or lifecycle rescue tuning.
